posts.text: Grateful and excited to have taken home first place at the Pitch the Future Case Competition, hosted by Western Founders Network in partnership with Accenture! It was such a pleasure collaborating with Lily Nguyen, Amy Wang, and Bella Z.. I loved seeing our ideas come to life our first brainstorm to the final pitch. A huge thank you to Western Founders Network and Accenture for making this amazing opportunity possible! #CaseCompetition #WesternUniversity #Accenture #WesternFoundersNetwork
